connectors.name: UART0 connector (top)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; horizontal row, started at the end closest to the USB-C connector (J3, left edge), i.e. the leftmost pad.

connectors.name: I2C connector (top)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; horizontal row, started at the end closest to the USB-C connector (left edge), i.e. the leftmost pad.

connectors.name: GPIO_D connector (top right)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; horizontal row, started at the end closest to the USB-C connector (left edge), i.e. the leftmost pad.

connectors.name: SPK speaker connector (bottom)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; horizontal row, started at the end closest to the USB-C connector (left edge), i.e. the left pad.

uncertain: J10, J6, J7: pin names are printed in a legend box to the left of each connector, not at each pad; pad mapping assumes the legend's left-to-right order matches the pads.
J8: VON-/VOP+ are printed in a separate box to the right of the connector; VON- = left pad, VOP+ = right pad is inferred from the legend order.
notes: PCB render of the CrowPanel 3.5-inch board (ESP32 Display-3.5 Inch, DIS05035H, V2.0). Combined legends printed as 'IO3-RXD', 'IO21-SCL' etc. split into GPIO label plus function. 'IO26-SPK' box near J8 is a signal note, not a pin. Skipped: J3 USB-C (UART0), J5 BAT battery connector, TF slot SD1, BOOT/RESET buttons.
